themes.counterRead: Index-level calm can mask real weakness concentrated in the handful of names that dominate the index by weight. The rotation read holds only while credit stays loose; if lending standards or HY OAS flip, the same price action re-reads as a rollover. Do not use SPY's 5.2% drawdown as comfort for the AI complex.

Bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 1.7%, far below the ~40% stress threshold), and HY OAS is 3.23 and calm.
